description: This file appears to be a main package for a Go-based server application related to the Android Cuttlefish project. It sets up HTTP and HTTPS servers, handles command-line flags, initializes operator components, and creates HTTP handlers for proxying and static file serving.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on the specified address and port, logs the listening address.

methods.name: startHttpsServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTPS server with TLS certificates located at specified paths, listening on the given address and port.

methods.name: maybeIntercept
methods.description: Determines if a request path should be intercepted and served from a specific directory, mainly for serving certain JavaScript files.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs multiple server starter functions concurrently and waits for their completion, handling errors by logging and terminating.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The program entry point; parses CLI flags, configures servers, initializes components, and starts the HTTP/HTTPS servers accordingly.
